c1.note: Ramp's own release dated Oct 15, 2026 states $60B valuation; Reuters, Bloomberg, TechCrunch confirm; no later round found.

c2.note: Release says $1.85B primary financing round led by Dragoneer valuing company at $60B.

c3.note: Dragoneer led the round per release and Reuters.

c4.note: Release lists Thrive, Founders Fund, Sands, Avenir Growth as co-leads.

c5.note: Reuters says valuation rose from $44B in June, when it raised $750M; TechCrunch and Bloomberg June articles confirm.

c7.note: Release: approximately $5 billion total equity financing including this round.

c9.note: Release: more than $2B annualized revenue; TechCrunch notes up from reported $1.5B in June.

c11.note: Release: revenue growing 25% faster than at same time last year.

c12.note: Release: over $275B annualized purchase volume, up 175% YoY.

c13.note: TechCrunch states 85,000 customers up from 70,000 in June with the listed names.

c15.note: Release states over $2B annualized revenue with positive cash flow; Reuters concurs.

c16.note: Bloomberg article dated Oct 9, 2026 reports roughly $60B valuation per people familiar with the matter; the company confirmed it Oct 15.

c17.note: Release says only 'valuing the company at $60 billion' with no pre/post-money designation.

c19.note: Ramp is private and $60B is the Oct 15, 2026 primary round valuation. All variants (C, E, F) are consistent with this and none contradicts it.

c6.note: Search results show GetLatka pages carrying stale figures: a $32B profile and a $44B comparison page. A $44B listing therefore exists, but I did not open the page myself.

c14.note: Ramp was valued at $13B in March 2025, $16B in June 2025 and $22.5B on July 30, 2025, so it was not about $13B in July 2025.

c21.note: The release footnote defines the figure as interchange, subscription, interest and other revenue, excluding customer incentives. The 'not audited' part is an inference, since Ramp is private and the release gives no audit statement.

c12.note: Ramp's Oct 15, 2026 press release (PRNewswire) and TechCrunch both say over $275B in annualized purchase volume, up 175% year over year. This is the latest reported figure.

c15.note: Ramp's Oct 15, 2026 press release says it has over $2B in annualized revenue 'with positive cash flow'.
